title: The Narrows: Twelve Weeks to Stabilize Selene
summary: A twelve-week supply-crisis exercise coupling food, fuel, transport, port repair, copper exports, and foreign-exchange reserves.

modes.description: Action families unlock in stages and major event timing is fixed.
All action families are available and declared event parameters vary by seed.
All action families are available for unconstrained model exploration.

primaryLearningObjectives.label: Distinguish an inventory level from its net rate of change.
Order against lead time rather than waiting for a visible shortage.
Identify how the binding constraint moves across port, rail, fuel, finance, and implementation capacity.
Reason about the coupling between physical resources and foreign exchange.
Treat administrative teams and policy churn as real constraints.
Request imperfect information early enough for it to change a decision.
